nodes.bdb: Jotham = "Jehovah is perfect" son of king Uzziah of Judah by Jerushah; king of Judah for 16 years and contemporary with Isaiah and king Pekah of Israel son of Jahdai and a descendant of Caleb and Judah youngest son of Gideon who escaped from the massacre of his brothers
